title: Daddy's Missing Sandwich
can_do: 听大人讲一件事时，主动追问“后来呢”，把故事听完。

conversation_move.label: ask what happened next in a story

trigger: Dad starts telling a small true story from his day and pauses between parts, leaving space for Child to ask for more.
setting: After dinner, in the cozy living room.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Something funny happened at work today.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: What happened, Daddy? Tell me everything!

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: I opened my bag, and my sandwich was gone.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Your sandwich was gone? What happened next?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: I looked everywhere, then under my hat.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: What did you find under your hat?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: That's so silly. Did you still eat it?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: I did, and it tasted fine.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Tomorrow, please check your hat first!

replay_cards.title: Grandma's train story
replay_cards.setting: Grandma visits and starts telling about her train ride.
replay_cards.change: She pauses before the best part to sip her tea.
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks what happened next until the story ends, then adds one comment of his own about the trip.

replay_cards.title: The found mitten
replay_cards.setting: Teacher tells the class she found something funny on the playground.
replay_cards.change: She stops before saying where she found it.
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks follow-up questions to hear the whole small story, and the class learns it was a mitten in the slide tunnel.

parent_support: 爸爸讲一件真事，故意在关键处停一停，等孩子问“后来呢”再继续。
孩子忘了问时，用半句提示“然后呢……”留白，不替他问。
任何形式的追问都算成功，追问本身比问得漂亮更重要。
